_comment: STEAMHOLLOW - a bathhouse village lost in fog. A walk-and-soak world (no goal, no puzzle): wooden boardwalks, hot-spring pools breathing steam, paper lanterns and timber bathhouses, all half-hidden in drifting mist that leaves you about two steps of clear view (atmosphere.fog, MistVeil; atmosphere.steam, SteamPuffs). Eight regions: Lantern Landing (where you arrive), Kettle Row (the bathhouse street), Soak Terraces, Cedar Walk, Drying Green, Old Springs, Maple Bank and the Stillwater Nook. It RE-SKINS ITSELF through its 'art' block (deep-merged over data/art.json): its own damp ground + litter atlas, cedars/maples/willows (tree entries [x, y, kind]), milky hot-spring water, plate boardwalks, timber bathhouses (buildings with view 'bathhouse'), lantern light. Its secret is a faint bronze bell: see the 'secret' block (reveal type 'listen'). Generated by tools/gen_steamhollow_world.py (art: pokepals/tools/gen_steamhollow.py) - edit that and re-run, don't hand-tune positions.
intro: Mist, and lamplight, and the sound of water. You can see about two steps ahead, and that is plenty. Somewhere out here a very small bell is ringing, too softly for you.

props.label: a paper lantern
props.lore: A paper lantern on a post, lit from inside. Its light makes a small warm room in the mist, just big enough for you and your companion.

props.label: a notice board
props.lore: A weathered notice board. 'WELCOME TO STEAMHOLLOW. Baths are hot, the mist is thick, and nobody here minds if you are late. Please do not hurry the water.'

props.label: the bellkeeper's board
props.lore: The bellkeeper's board: 'The little bell by the cold spring has gone too quiet for people to hear again. It never stops ringing; we only stop listening. If you've a companion, stand still together and let it listen. Mind you, it hears best when it is calm, and it hears nothing at all if you hurry.'

props.label: a notice board
props.lore: The boardwalk ends here, and the cedars begin. Someone has chalked below the old notice: 'Past this point the mist is all there is. Stand still. Let the little one listen.'

props.label: a little stone guardian
props.lore: A small stone guardian in a faded red bib, mossy at the feet. Travellers leave it a pebble for company. You do, too.

props.label: a bath stool
props.lore: A low wooden stool, still damp. Whoever sat here has only just gone in. Their sandals are lined up very neatly beside it.

props.label: a wooden bucket
props.lore: A bucket of water, still warm. A ladle floats in it, turning slowly, like it's thinking.

props.label: a bench by the foot bath
props.lore: A bench beside a small hot pool. The boards under it are worn smooth in exactly two places.

props.label: a bench by the foot bath
props.lore: A bench with a view of nothing: just steam, and the shape of the next lantern.

props.label: a rack of towels
props.lore: Towels hang from the rack and never seem to dry. They drip, quietly, in a rhythm. You find yourself counting it.

props.label: a rack of towels
props.lore: A long rack of towels, cream and indigo, all hanging a little crooked. A very small footprint leads out from under it and back in again.

props.label: a rack of towels
props.lore: Someone hung their towel here to dry a long time ago, and it's cheerfully refused.

props.label: an old stone basin
props.lore: A stone basin, older than the boardwalks. It still holds hot water, and a single yellow leaf that has been going round and round for who knows how long.

props.label: a steam vent
props.lore: A breath of steam rises from a crack in the stone, in no hurry, every few seconds, like the ground sighing in its sleep.

props.label: a bench under the maples
props.lore: A bench under a maple, red leaves collected on it. You sit down, and the leaves rearrange themselves around you.

props.label: a bellkeeper's stool
props.lore: A small stool, set down on purpose. Whoever sat here sat very still for a very long time, listening.

props.label: a glass jar on a little table
props.lore: A glass jar on a little table by the bell post, its lid set beside it. A few fireflies have found their way here through the fog and stayed, as if the bell were ringing for them too. They drift lower when you come near.

_firefly_glades_comment: Where fireflies gather (usable items, crafting): beside the secret, at the end of the world. The glade has a glass jar on a little table (a 'firefly_jar' prop): examine it and a firefly drifts down into the jar for you. You carry one at a time; the tinker in the bazaar makes a lantern with one. The server honours a catch only at a jar.
_secret_comment: This world's one SECRET (docs/home-world-and-secrets-design.md, 'Steamhollow'). reveal.type 'listen': a bronze bell hangs in the fog, ringing too faintly to hear. When the companion is calm and settled beside the player (player still or slow, companion close and standing easy) and within hearing (range by bond), its gaze turns toward the bell and its ears prick (ListenGuide / ListenDirector); near the bell the tell sharpens and the bell shows in the mist. The server honours a claim only here, within 'radius' of 'position'.

secret.lore: A little bronze bell on a leaning post, no bigger than a fist. You hold still and hear nothing at all. Your companion is looking at it as if it had said its name.

lines.hear: Your companion goes still. Its ears prick, and it turns its head, listening to something you can't hear.
lines.lost: It lowers its ears. Whatever it was hearing has slipped away. Stand still together, and it may hear it again.
lines.near: Your companion's whole body is leaning toward the mist now, tail still, ears forward. You must be getting closer.
lines.close: A small glint, in the mist ahead: bronze, hanging very still.

secret.found_line: It had been ringing all along, too softly for anyone but the little one beside you. Now you know the sound is there.

keepsake.label: a little bronze bell on a stand
keepsake.line: A bell too quiet for you to hear. Your companion tilts its head toward it now and then, and listens.

portals.label: the way back to the Vale
